_readme: Single source of truth for the site. Values beginning with 'TBD' render as placeholders. Never invent values to replace a TBD.

person.epitaph: A simple, humble man who asked for little and gave his family everything.
person.survivingSiblings: TBD — confirm which of: Frankie, Terry, Marlon, Marie, Martha, Tony, Art, Joey
person.precededInDeathBy: TBD — parents plus deceased siblings by name
person.parishOfOrigin: Assumption of Our Lady Catholic Church, Piti, Guam (parish founded 1955; confirm wording with Uncle Joey)

service.army: United States Army, September 1975 – August 1995 (20 years). Infantry; drill sergeant from 1988. Stations: Germany; Fort Sill, Oklahoma (1988–1991); Washington (1992); Guam (1994–1995); retired in Washington.

viewing.title: Viewing & Rosary
viewing.notes: Come any time during the viewing. The family prays the Rosary together at 1:00 PM.

funeralMass.title: Funeral Mass
funeralMass.timeDisplay: Mass begins promptly at 10:00 AM · Rosary at 9:00 AM
funeralMass.venueName: St. John of the Woods Catholic Church
whatToExpect: 9:00 AM — the Rosary, led by Monique Chapman.
The casket is open for family to pay their respects until Mass begins.
10:00 AM — Vincent Calip shares words of remembrance. Father then blesses the casket, and the procession to the altar begins the Mass.
After Communion, family members may share a few words when Father invites them.
funeralMass.reception: A reception follows in the church hall. Father will announce it at the end of Mass.
funeralMass.notes: Please arrive by 9:30 AM so you are seated before Mass begins.

interment.title: Interment with Military Honors
interment.warning: The cemetery runs on a strict military schedule and cannot hold a service for late arrivals. It is a Friday morning — allow extra time for traffic and construction, and plan to leave early.
interment.notes: Interment means burial. Because Patrick served twenty years in the U.S. Army, he will be laid to rest with military honors — a short ceremony by uniformed service members that usually includes the playing of Taps and the folding of the American flag, which is presented to the family.

scriptures.label: First Reading
scriptures.summary: The faithful who have died rest safely in God’s hands. To the world they seemed to leave us, but they are at peace.

scriptures.label: Responsorial Psalm
scriptures.ref: Psalm 23 · The Lord Is My Shepherd
scriptures.summary: God leads us like a shepherd, beside still waters and through the darkest valley, and brings us home to his house.

scriptures.label: Second Reading
scriptures.summary: Saint Paul writes that in baptism we share in Christ’s death, so that we may also share in his new life. Death no longer has power over him.

scriptures.label: Gospel
scriptures.ref: TBD — Gospel passage not yet confirmed

program.acknowledgments: The family of Patrick Cabrera thanks everyone who has surrounded us with prayers, food, and presence these past weeks. Your kindness reflects the man we are honoring. Special thanks to Father Tuan, Father Hendry, the St. John of the Woods Lazarus Ministry, and the staff of Mountain View Funeral Home.
program.acknowledgmentsSignoff: Mary, Gina, Bella, Vincent, Isaac, Roxy, Monique, and the Cabrera family
program._source: Order of service from Darlene, St. John of the Woods Lazarus Ministry (call with Vince, 2026-10-12). Fr. Tuan may adjust timing on the day.
program.music: Hymn titles and singers TBD (Vince is confirming full names). Responsorial Psalm: The Lord Is My Shepherd (Psalm 23).

giving.headline: Ways to help the family
giving.text: Many of you have asked how you can help. Gifts will go toward meals, travel for family coming from Guam, and the costs of these days.
giving.tipNote: GoFundMe suggests an optional tip at checkout. It goes to GoFundMe, not the family. To skip it, tap “Enter custom tip” and type 0.
giving.inPerson: If you'd rather bring a card to the viewing or the Mass, there will be a place for it there.
